0126SOUNDS.  EMBEDDED IN THE JAGGED ROOF FAR OVERHEAD ARE MYRIAD TWISTED

0126THE RIGHT, AN IMMENSE GEYSER OF BLISTERING STEAM ERUPTS CONTINUOUSLY

0001SOMEWHERE NEARBY IS COLLOSAL CAVE, WHERE OTHERS HAVE FOUND FORTUNES IN
0001TREASURE AND GOLD, THOUGH IT IS RUMORED THAT SOME WHO ENTER ARE NEVER
0001SEEN AGAIN.  MAGIC IS SAID TO WORK IN THE CAVE.  I WILL BE YOUR EYES
0001AND HANDS.  DIRECT ME WITH COMMANDS OF 1 OR 2 WORDS.  I SHOULD WARN
0001YOU THAT I LOOK AT ONLY THE FIRST FOUR LETTERS OF EACH WORD, SO YOU'LL
0001HAVE TO ENTER "NORTHEAST" AS "NE" TO DISTINGUISH IT FROM "NORTH".
0001(SHOULD YOU GET STUCK, TYPE "HELP" FOR SOME GENERAL HINTS.  FOR INFOR-
0001MATION ON HOW TO END YOUR ADVENTURE, ETC., TYPE "INFO".)
0001      - - -
0001THIS PROGRAM WAS ORIGINALLY DEVELOPED BY WILLIE CROWTHER.  MOST OF THE
0001FEATURES OF THE CURRENT PROGRAM WERE ADDED BY DON WOODS (DON @ SU-AI).
0001THE CURRENT DEC VERSION WAS DONE BY BOB SUPNIK.  THE CONVERSION TO
0001SCOPE WAS DONE BY R. EMERSON, W. WIRTH, S. HOBSON, W. HEIN, S. CONNARD,
0001AND A CAST OF THOUSANDS....
0001             FURTHER CONVERSION TO NOS 1.3 WAS DONE BY

0050GOOD TRY, BUT THAT IS AN OLD WORN-OUT MAGIC WORD.
0051I KNOW OF PLACES, ACTIONS, AND THINGS.  MOST OF MY VOCABULARY
0051DESCRIBES PLACES AND IS USED TO MOVE YOU THERE.  TO MOVE, TRY WORDS
0051LIKE FOREST, BUILDING, DNSTREAM, ENTER, EAST, WEST, NORTH, SOUTH,
0051UP, OR DOWN.  I KNOW ABOUT A FEW SPECIAL OBJECTS, LIKE A BLACK ROD
0051HIDDEN IN THE CAVE.  THESE OBJECTS CAN BE MANIPULATED USING SOME OF
0051THE ACTION WORDS THAT I KNOW.  USUALLY YOU WILL NEED TO GIVE BOTH THE
0051OBJECT AND ACTION WORDS (IN EITHER ORDER), BUT SOMETIMES I CAN INFER
0051THE OBJECT FROM THE VERB ALONE.  SOME OBJECTS ALSO IMPLY VERBS; IN
0051PARTICULAR, "INVENTORY" IMPLIES "TAKE INVENTORY", WHICH CAUSES ME TO
0051GIVE YOU A LIST OF WHAT YOU'RE CARRYING.  THE OBJECTS HAVE SIDE
0051EFFECTS; FOR INSTANCE, THE ROD SCARES THE BIRD.  USUALLY PEOPLE HAVING
0051TROUBLE MOVING JUST NEED TO TRY A FEW MORE WORDS.  USUALLY PEOPLE
0051TRYING UNSUCCESSFULLY TO MANIPULATE AN OBJECT ARE ATTEMPTING SOMETHING
0051BEYOND THEIR (OR MY!) CAPABILITIES AND SHOULD TRY A COMPLETELY
0051DIFFERENT TACK.  TO SPEED THE GAME YOU CAN SOMETIMES MOVE LONG
0051DISTANCES WITH A SINGLE WORD.  FOR EXAMPLE, "BUILDING" USUALLY GETS
0051YOU TO THE BUILDING FROM ANYWHERE ABOVE GROUND EXCEPT WHEN LOST IN THE
0051FOREST.  ALSO, NOTE THAT CAVE PASSAGES TURN A LOT, AND THAT LEAVING A
0051ROOM TO THE NORTH DOES NOT GUARANTEE ENTERING THE NEXT FROM THE SOUTH.
0051GOOD LUCK!

0138I DARESAY WHATEVER YOU WANT IS AROUND HERE SOMEWHERE.
0139I DON'T KNOW THE WORD "STOP".  USE "QUIT" IF YOU WANT TO GIVE UP.
0140YOU CAN'T GET THERE FROM HERE.
0141YOU ARE BEING FOLLOWED BY A VERY LARGE, TAME BEAR.
0142IF YOU WANT TO END YOUR ADVENTURE EARLY, SAY "QUIT".  TO SUSPEND YOUR
0142ADVENTURE SUCH THAT YOU CAN CONTINUE LATER, SAY "SUSPEND" (OR "PAUSE"
0142OR "SAVE").  TO SEE WHAT HOURS THE CAVE IS NORMALLY OPEN, SAY "HOURS".
0142TO SEE HOW WELL YOU'RE DOING, SAY "SCORE".  TO GET FULL CREDIT FOR A
0142TREASURE, YOU MUST HAVE LEFT IT SAFELY IN THE BUILDING, THOUGH YOU GET
0142PARTIAL CREDIT JUST FOR LOCATING IT.  YOU LOSE POINTS FOR GETTING
0142KILLED, OR FOR QUITTING, THOUGH THE FORMER COSTS YOU MORE.  THERE ARE
0142ALSO POINTS BASED ON HOW MUCH (IF ANY) OF THE CAVE YOU'VE MANAGED TO
0142EXPLORE; IN PARTICULAR, THERE IS A LARGE BONUS JUST FOR GETTING IN (TO
0142DISTINGUISH THE BEGINNERS FROM THE REST OF THE PACK), AND THERE ARE
0142OTHER WAYS TO DETERMINE WHETHER YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH SOME OF THE MORE
0142HARROWING SECTIONS.  IF YOU THINK YOU'VE FOUND ALL THE TREASURES, JUST
0142KEEP EXPLORING FOR A WHILE.  IF NOTHING INTERESTING HAPPENS, YOU
0142HAVEN'T FOUND THEM ALL YET.  IF SOMETHING INTERESTING *DOES* HAPPEN,
0142IT MEANS YOU'RE GETTING A BONUS AND HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO GARNER MANY
0142MORE POINTS IN THE MASTER'S SECTION.  I MAY OCCASIONALLY OFFER HINTS
0142IF YOU SEEM TO BE HAVING TROUBLE.  IF I DO, I'LL WARN YOU IN ADVANCE
0142HOW MUCH IT WILL AFFECT YOUR SCORE TO ACCEPT THE HINTS.  FINALLY, TO
0142SAVE PAPER, YOU MAY SPECIFY "BRIEF", WHICH TELLS ME NEVER TO REPEAT
0142THE FULL DESCRIPTION OF A PLACE UNLESS YOU EXPLICITLY ASK ME TO.
0143DO YOU INDEED WISH TO QUIT NOW?
0144THERE IS NOTHING HERE WITH WHICH TO FILL THE VASE.
0145THE SUDDEN CHANGE IN TEMPERATURE HAS DELICATELY SHATTERED THE VASE.
0146IT IS BEYOND YOUR POWER TO DO THAT.
0147I DON'T KNOW HOW.
0148IT IS TOO FAR UP FOR YOU TO REACH.
0149YOU KILLED A LITTLE DWARF.  THE BODY VANISHES IN A CLOUD OF GREASY
0149BLACK SMOKE.
0150THE SHELL IS VERY STRONG AND IS IMPERVIOUS TO ATTACK.
0151WHAT'S THE MATTER, CAN'T YOU READ?  NOW YOU'D BEST START OVER.
0152THE AXE BOUNCES HARMLESSLY OFF THE DRAGON'S THICK SCALES.
0153THE DRAGON LOOKS RATHER NASTY.  YOU'D BEST NOT TRY TO GET BY.
0154THE LITTLE BIRD ATTACKS THE GREEN DRAGON, AND IN AN ASTOUNDING FLURRY
0154GETS BURNT TO A CINDER.  THE ASHES BLOW AWAY.
0155ON WHAT?
0156OKAY, FROM NOW ON I'LL ONLY DESCRIBE A PLACE IN FULL THE FIRST TIME
0156YOU COME TO IT.  TO GET THE FULL DESCRIPTION, SAY "LOOK".
0157TROLLS ARE CLOSE RELATIVES WITH THE ROCKS AND HAVE SKIN AS TOUGH AS
0157THAT OF A RHINOCEROS.  THE TROLL FENDS OFF YOUR BLOWS EFFORTLESSLY.
0158THE TROLL DEFTLY CATCHES THE AXE, EXAMINES IT CAREFULLY, AND TOSSES IT
0158BACK, DECLARING, "GOOD WORKMANSHIP, BUT IT'S NOT VALUABLE ENOUGH."
0159THE TROLL CATCHES YOUR TREASURE AND SCURRIES AWAY OUT OF SIGHT.
0160THE TROLL REFUSES TO LET YOU CROSS.
0161THERE IS NO LONGER ANY WAY ACROSS THE CHASM.
0162JUST AS YOU REACH THE OTHER SIDE, THE BRIDGE BUCKLES BENEATH THE
0162WEIGHT OF THE BEAR, WHICH WAS STILL FOLLOWING YOU AROUND.  YOU
0162SCRABBLE DESPERATELY FOR SUPPORT, BUT AS THE BRIDGE COLLAPSES YOU
0162STUMBLE BACK AND FALL INTO THE CHASM.
0163THE BEAR LUMBERS TOWARD THE TROLL, WHO LETS OUT A STARTLED SHRIEK AND
0163SCURRIES AWAY.  THE BEAR SOON GIVES UP THE PURSUIT AND WANDERS BACK.
0164THE AXE MISSES AND LANDS NEAR THE BEAR WHERE YOU CAN'T GET AT IT.
0165WITH WHAT?  YOUR BARE HANDS?  AGAINST *HIS* BEAR HANDS??
0166THE BEAR IS CONFUSED; HE ONLY WANTS TO BE YOUR FRIEND.
0167FOR CRYING OUT LOUD, THE POOR THING IS ALREADY DEAD!
0168THE BEAR EAGERLY WOLFS DOWN YOUR FOOD, AFTER WHICH HE SEEMS TO CALM
0168DOWN CONSIDERABLY AND EVEN BECOMES RATHER FRIENDLY.
0169THE BEAR IS STILL CHAINED TO THE WALL.
0170THE CHAIN IS STILL LOCKED.
0171THE CHAIN IS NOW UNLOCKED.
0172THE CHAIN IS NOW LOCKED.
0173THERE IS NOTHING HERE TO WHICH THE CHAIN CAN BE LOCKED.
0174THERE IS NOTHING HERE TO EAT.
0175DO YOU WANT THE HINT?
0176DO YOU NEED HELP GETTING OUT OF THE MAZE?
0177YOU CAN MAKE THE PASSAGES LOOK LESS ALIKE BY DROPPING THINGS.
0178ARE YOU TRYING TO EXPLORE BEYOND THE PLOVER ROOM?
0179THERE IS A WAY TO EXPLORE THAT REGION WITHOUT HAVING TO WORRY ABOUT
0179FALLING INTO A PIT.  NONE OF THE OBJECTS AVAILABLE IS IMMEDIATELY
0179USEFUL IN DISCOVERING THE SECRET.
0180DO YOU NEED HELP GETTING OUT OF HERE?
0181DON'T GO WEST.
0182GLUTTONY IS NOT ONE OF THE TROLL'S VICES.  AVARICE, HOWEVER, IS.
0183YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  YOU'D BEST START WRAPPING THIS UP, UNLESS
0183YOU CAN FIND SOME FRESH BATTERIES.  I SEEM TO RECALL THERE'S A VENDING
0183MACHINE IN THE MAZE.  BRING SOME COINS WITH YOU.
0184YOUR LAMP HAS RUN OUT OF POWER.
0185THERE'S NOT MUCH POINT IN WANDERING AROUND OUT HERE, AND YOU CAN'T
0185EXPLORE THE CAVE WITHOUT A LAMP.  SO LET'S JUST CALL IT A DAY.
0186THERE ARE FAINT RUSTLING NOISES FROM THE DARKNESS BEHIND YOU.  AS YOU
0186TURN TOWARD THEM, THE BEAM OF YOUR LAMP FALLS ACROSS A BEARDED PIRATE.
0186HE IS CARRYING A LARGE CHEST.  "SHIVER ME TIMBERS!" HE CRIES, "I'VE
0186BEEN SPOTTED!  I'D BEST HIE MESELF OFF TO THE MAZE TO HIDE ME CHEST!"
0186WITH THAT, HE VANISHES INTO THE GLOOM.
0187YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  YOU'D BEST GO BACK FOR THOSE BATTERIES.
0188YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM.  I'M TAKING THE LIBERTY OF REPLACING THE
0188BATTERIES.
0189YOUR LAMP IS GETTING DIM, AND YOU'RE OUT OF SPARE BATTERIES.  YOU'D
0189BEST START WRAPPING THIS UP.
0190I'M AFRAID THE MAGAZINE IS WRITTEN IN DWARVISH.
0191"THIS IS NOT THE MAZE WHERE THE PIRATE LEAVES HIS TREASURE CHEST."
0192HMMM, THIS LOOKS LIKE A CLUE, WHICH MEANS IT'LL COST YOU 10 POINTS TO
0192READ IT.  SHOULD I GO AHEAD AND READ IT ANYWAY?
0193IT SAYS, "THERE IS SOMETHING STRANGE ABOUT THIS PLACE, SUCH THAT ONE
0193OF THE WORDS I'VE ALWAYS KNOWN NOW HAS A NEW EFFECT."
0194IT SAYS THE SAME THING IT DID BEFORE.
0195I'M AFRAID I DON'T UNDERSTAND.
0196"CONGRATULATIONS ON BRINGING LIGHT INTO THE DARK-ROOM!"
0197YOU STRIKE THE MIRROR A RESOUNDING BLOW, WHEREUPON IT SHATTERS INTO A
0197MYRIAD TINY FRAGMENTS.
0198YOU HAVE TAKEN THE VASE AND HURLED IT DELICATELY TO THE GROUND.
0199YOU PROD THE NEAREST DWARF, WHO WAKES UP GRUMPILY, TAKES ONE LOOK AT
0199YOU, CURSES, AND GRABS FOR HIS AXE.
0200IS THIS ACCEPTABLE?
